request.style: English, anthemic rock, powerful female rock vocal, layered electric guitars, bass guitar, big drums, piano, trumpet call in the bridge, triumphant through grief, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Listen, I tell you a mystery, it is written in the word
We will not all sleep, but the trumpet will be heard
In an instant, in the blink of an eye
The dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed

[Chorus]
Where, O death, is your victory
Where, O death, is your sting
Death has been swallowed up in victory
But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory
Through our Lord Jesus Christ

[Verse]
Every body that is breaking, every friend we laid to rest
Will put on the imperishable and rise up from the dust
The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law
But the victory is given us, the grave has lost its claw

[Chorus]
Where, O death, is your victory
Where, O death, is your sting
Death has been swallowed up in victory
But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory
Through our Lord Jesus Christ

[Bridge]
For the trumpet will sound
And the dead will be raised imperishable
And we will be changed
This mortal body must put on immortality

[Outro]
Where, O death, is your sting
Thanks be to God
